title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1247: Saintless skies (1)

section.p: Thanks to Grandstar, Zhu Tiandao became famous. More famous than before, to be specific. Now, his name was known across the Myriad Realms. The one who had slain four Invincibles in one day. Not an Invincible, yet slaughtering Invincibles like they were bugs.

As for whether people would actually believe this…things had changed. If even Wan Tiansheng, a so-called peak Mountainsea, could slay two Invincibles in one day, why couldn’t Zhu Tiandao do better than that?

Everyone was more surprised at the speed with which the three Invincibles had died. They had died in succession, making it clear that they had been killed together. It was possible that Zhu Tiandao had received the assistance of Wan Tiansheng and Lan Tian. Some guessed that Lan Tian was actually strong enough to kill Invincibles as well. Some also speculated that Wan Tiansheng was actually not that badly injured, so he must have helped significantly during the battle.

With three of them joining hands, it would be much less surprising for three Invincibles to die in succession against them. In fact, that was the conclusion of the three Invincibles who were still fighting Great Han King in the Human Realm. They had seen the three leaving Nanyuan with their own eyes.

Of course, First Yellow was also present when the three Invincibles died. When his identity was exposed, he would probably get to share some of the glory as well. After all, that glory was a tad bit too big for Zhu Tiandao, Wan Tiansheng, and Lan Tian to monopolize.
At the other side of the sealed portal.
Zhu Tiandao felt like crying as he muttered, “I better affirm my dao in the Human Realm today. Otherwise…I will never get a chance to affirm my dao anymore.”
After his amazing feats today, he could forget about affirming his dao in the future. The myriad races would not allow it to happen.

Wan Tiansheng glanced at Old Zhu and asked, “Maybe you can…do us one more favor? Show your face in the Allheaven Prefecture and announce your dao affirmation. Perhaps that will pull more enemies away from Xia Longwu…”
As the three were conversing, someone descended from the sky with two items in his hand. That person seemed incredibly happy.
Su Yu was in a great mood. This was so profitable! He had gained two more carrier treasures. He already had two prior to this. And now, he had four.
So carrier treasures weren’t that rare, after all. That was Su Yu’s conclusion.

Previously, he had three carrier treasures. One was destroyed, leaving him with two. And now, he had four carrier treasures in total. The number of carrier treasures in his possession was increasing steadily.

Between the three dead Invincibles, five carrier treasures should have appeared since Lade was left with only one body. But the stone statue was too strong and three of the carrier treasures had been destroyed during the short battle.

In fact, Su Yu could already count himself lucky that two of the carrier treasures had survived. Of the two carrier treasures, one was a small tree left behind by Divine King Huoji. And a decent amount of his blood was still left on the tree. It might even be possible to produce a drop of blood essence out of the blood on the tree.

And this was not all Su Yu had gained. As Divine King Huoji had been killed in the Allheaven Battlefield and Su Yu had been able to throw some punches toward the divine king, he was considered one of the killers. He was rewarded with a large amount of heavenearth profound light, willpower, and a few characters.

He had received all that just from throwing some random punches at the dying divine king. He had probably contributed less than 0.001 percent of the total damage required to kill the divine king. Even so, he had been rewarded so richly.

With the rewards, his body shook as he finally completed his sixty-third body forging. Even before this, he was already near completion. After the intense battle against the young geniuses, he only needed a tiny push to complete this round of body forging.

Even as he completed his body forging, his willpower grew rapidly. His sea of willpower swelled as the willpower threatened to overflow out of it. The characters he received from the heavenly reward were instantly destroyed as they weren’t human characters, releasing a burst of willpower and character intent in his sea of willpower. Delighted, the little furball started a feast in the sea of willpower.

As his willpower grew, Su Yu started tempering his sea of willpower with his Soul Expanding Hammer. After his previous breakthrough to the ninth-stage Cloudbreach Realm, he had spent a long time hammering himself to push him back to early ninth-stage Cloudbreach Realm. And now, his willpower was going through yet another exponential growth.

As the sea of willpower started growing in size, Su Yu continued hammering it. It wasn’t like he had any other option. He had yet to fuse his apertures. Thus, even if he allowed his willpower to grow, he wouldn’t be able to enter the Mountainsea Realm. Instead, he might risk his sea of willpower bursting apart.
While all that was happening, his characters were also growing. Most of his characters that were still stuck below the fourth tier started advancing, his newly formed culture character included.
Of his twenty-seven characters, more than half had reached the fourth tier. Fortunately, his sea of willpower was durable enough to contain so many powerful characters.

After he killed Jiu Xuan of the immortal race previously, he had discovered thirty-six new apertures. He had yet to open all those apertures, so he was also taking this chance to open more of those apertures.
He had been rewarded richly even though he had only contributed a tiny bit to the death of the Invincible. That was mainly due to the massive gap between his strength and the Invincible’s.

Before long, his number of opened apertures reached 216. At this point, his sea of willpower was already comparable to that of a middle-stage Mountainsea in size. And it was still growing, nearing the level of a late-stage Mountainsea. The strength of his willpower had also reached the level of a Mountainsea.

In fact, one could already consider him a Pseudo Mountainsea. He was only being held back my the lack of aperture fusion. For most cultivators, the purpose of aperture fusion was the strengthening of their willpower. Meanwhile, Su Yu had done the same through sheer tempering with his hammer.

Then, his body shook as he completed yet another body forging. Even with this, he still had plenty of heavenly rewards left. In fact, he had enough rewards to complete at least two or three more forgings. He was quite surprised at how much he had benefited from merely throwing some useless punches at the Invincible.

He was also starting to feel regret. Out of the three Invincibles, he had only contributed to the death of one of them. If he had known this, he would have done the same to all three of them. The more he thought about it, the more regretful he felt.
He started wondering about his missed rewards. Would he be able to jump straight to the seventy-second body forging if he hadn’t missed those rewards? Would his willpower grow even stronger?
He felt terrible.

While Su Yu was grieving over his missed rewards, Wan Tiansheng, Lan Tian, and Zhu Tiandao were watching as the kid went through multiple breakthroughs right in front of their eyes. From the waves of willpower churning around him, it was clear his willpower had reached the level of a Mountainsea.

As for his physical strength…it was hard for them to judge since he had consumed some blood essence earlier. In truth, after the completion of two additional body forgings, his body had reached the strength of no less than 800,000 acupoints.

And with his yang acupoint open, his strength had doubled. With just his body and yang acupoint, he could muster the strength of no less than 1.6 million acupoints. He was already insanely strong even without consuming blood essence. Unfortunately, he could no longer close his yang acupoint. That might prove troublesome in some ways.

Then again, Su Yu wasn’t too bothered. There was a benefit to opening the yang acupoint. He no longer needed to waste his time dealing with Xing Yue’s death qi. No matter how much death qi he received, the yang acupoint would be there to absorb everything.

He didn’t even need to waste his time reversing the death qi in his body anymore. In fact, he was looking forward to receiving more death qi from Xing Yue. He also started praying that Xing Yue wouldn’t die or he would be forced to feed the yang acupoint himself. If anyone dared to suggest that he sever his death qi connection, he would give that person a beating.

Xing Yue was now his sole lifeline. Severing the death qi connection would be the same as killing him. Without Xing Yue, how was he supposed to keep the yang acupoint fed? Just look at the old man from the Bai Family. He had spent countless years in seclusion just to feed his yang acupoint. Even when he was spending all his time cultivating, he was still unable to fully satisfy the yang acupoint. What a miserable life.

At the same time, Su Yu couldn’t help wondering about something else. If he were to kill an Invincible alone one day, would the heavenly rewards surpass what he could handle? At that time, he would probably burst apart from the sheer amount of energy crammed into his body.
Just look at how much he had gained from throwing some inconsequential attacks at the Invincible. If he had killed the Invincible himself…
He shook his head and decided to not worry about something like this for now.
“Kid!”
Suddenly, Lan Tian’s voice rang out, “Little Su Yu, you have four carrier treasures. Would you consider a loan to me? I need to fuse 10,000 bodies, and I still lack 9,999 carrrier treasures.”
Su Yu, Wan Tiansheng, and Zhu Tiandao stared at Lan Tian at the same time.
He was definitely crazy.
Was he aware of what he was saying?
Ten thousand?
He should drop down and die instead.

Lan Tian said, “Little Su Yu, after fusing ten thousand daos, I will become the number one expert under the heavens. If you’re willing to provide me with 9,999 carrier treasures, I will stay by your side forever and ever…”
Su Yu looked at Wan Tiansheng and Zhu Tiandao, asking silently if they could give this madman a beating for him.
Lan Tian…was making him uncomfortable.
Wan Tiansheng ignored their antics and said, “We need to leave. People will be here soon. The portal might have been sealed, but it might also reopen. We need to go back to Great Xia…”
The battle there was still ongoing.
Right at that moment, Great Han King’s voice rang out from afar, “Zhu Tiandao, get over here! They’re trying to flee!”
The three surviving Invincibles were not the only ones trying to flee. All the myriad race experts were fleeing.

The carrier treasures were gone. The Culture Tomb was gone as well. Were they supposed to stay and wait for Zhu Tiandao, the slayer of Invincibles to return and slay them all? This was a hopeless endeavor. Apart from the three Invincibles facing Great Han King, there was one more Invincible facing First Profound and the others.

Meanwhile, Zhu Tiandao had killed four Invincibles while Wan Tiansheng had killed two. Six Invincibles had died in the Human Realm in the span of one day. A dragon king had also been crippled, but that dragon king was probably feeling lucky he had survived. He might have lost two bodies, but at least he wasn’t dead.

The four remaining Invincibles in the Human Realm hurriedly regrouped before fleeing together. Great Han King and the others were hot in pursuit. In truth, four Invincibles were too much for them to handle.
Great Han King was already gravely injured. First Profound had yet to complete his dao affirmation. As for the Yellow Department head, he was still unable to assemble his main body.

If the four Invincibles fought seriously, they might still win. However, they were still fleeing unhesitatingly. If they remained, all of them would die when Zhu Tiandao, the slayer of Invincibles, was back.

When Zhu Tiandao heard Great Han King’s words, he curled his lips and rolled his eyes. If he were to face the four Invincibles, he might end up exposing himself. That would only put all of them in danger. Four Invincibles were not so easy to deal with.

Wan Tiansheng inhaled deeply and said, “The battle here is almost over. Those four Invincibles will probably escape through the other stable portal. The secret portal of the myriad races will be exposed. This isn’t a bad thing for us. Let them go.”

He looked at Su Yu and the others before saying, “You should lend some support to our people in the Allheaven Battlefield. Su Yu and Zhu Tiandao, even if you can’t handle Invincibles, you can at least attract some of their firepower from the others…”
“Are you trying to get me killed?”
Zhu Tiandao asked, “What about you?”
“I’m already a cripple.” Wan Tiansheng looked into the distance and said, “I’m already crippled, but I can still fight. Go. Go with Xia Xiao’er and the others. Help them.”
“And you’re going to stay at home while we fight?”
Wan Tiansheng smiled and looked around as he softly say, “I will take a good look at this Human Realm…”
Suddenly, Su Yu said, “Principal, all the human Invincibles are occupied. Why don’t…”

Wan Tiansheng said, “You don’t understand. This is only a start. Things will be even harder for humanity from now on. So many of us have affirmed their dao this time. Most of the time, the majority of our Invincibles will remain stationed in the Allheaven Prefecture. Someone needs to cleanse this filth from humanity.”

Lan Tian chimed in, “You have me by your side! Wherever you go, I’ll remain beside you! Let’s do something big! We can…simply leave after that. We can find someplace nobody knows us and live out the rest of our lives together.”
